title: Header
description: The combine's cutting table, exactly 1 m wide for the game to stretch: `bar` (floor pan, back wall, cutter bar with guards, cross auger) and `reel` (6 yellow bats on an axle at HEADER.reel) scale in X; `end_L` / `end_R` side shields with pointed crop dividers pivot at x = +/-0.5. Origin: back edge centre on the ground.
checks: LEFT tile: a low tray with a tall back wall at the back end, the reel up front above the floor, a pointed divider reaching forward past the cutter bar
FRONT tile: six yellow bats round the reel axle, an auger tube across the back, the side shields at both ends
3/4 tile: the reel axle sits in bearings on arms coming forward from the back wall top
TOP tile: the dividers point forward (toward the front end) and stand outside the 1 m bar on both sides
